# Backfill Timecards

> A private, offline-first utility for freelancers reconstructing weekly timecards.

Backfill Timecards helps a freelancer manually record work blocks, selectively import local calendar events, remember project-to-client mappings, reuse patterns, and export invoice-ready CSV. It does not track activity, infer time, monitor employees, or issue invoices. Work records remain in browser storage.

## Pages

- [Product](https://backfill-timecards.sociobot.in/): Local weekly reconstruction board
- [Privacy](https://backfill-timecards.sociobot.in/privacy/): Local storage and billing verification details
- [Terms](https://backfill-timecards.sociobot.in/terms/): Use and one-time unlock terms
